causes: The Compose default container UID/GID was 1000:1000 while the host-owned mode-0700 runtime tree was 1001:1001.
The model-adapter services inherited the image permission-model entrypoint, whose /app-only filesystem allowance denied the selected Unix socket directory.
The signer run-identity validator accepted study identities but not the prospectively parameterized application v2 identity.
correctionPolicy: Retain the v2 raw receipt and logs, bind the invoking host UID/GID, use explicit model-host entrypoints within the locked-down containers, extend the signer validator to application identities, capture live container observations even after a wait failure, and use a fresh v3 identity.
claimBoundary: This is an application-startup failure with no recorded turn or audit evidence, not a behavioral result, B12 closure, or publication evidence.
